entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'm calling because I'd like to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor that I recently purchased.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order was delivered 15 days ago. That's **no problem** at all. Our return policy allows for returns within **90 days** of delivery.
Oh, that's fantastic! I wasn't sure what the policy was. So, what do I do next?

I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid **return label** right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next minute or two. Just print that out, stick it on the original box, and you can drop it off with the post.
Wow, that was easy. I just got the email. Thank you so much for your help, Karen!

You're very welcome! Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
